name: Neuhausen ob Eck (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Neuhausen ob Eck (a yellow house on red under a yellow chief with a black antler).
history: Municipal arms and flag were granted by the Ministry of the Interior on 10 June 1968.

features.role: Neuhausen ob Eck arms — house and antler
